area: Marsh north-east of Abbey Mills toward Plaistow: LT&SR running east at about marsh level, the Northern Outfall Sewer crossing over it and running SE on its bank, open marsh with blue drains south of the py ~571 join, 'EAST' (Ham) display lettering
method: Sweep crops r0c0-r2c2 all displayed and anchored at opening (r0c0 N O R sewer lettering, LT&SR; r0c1 B.M.7·89 and S.P. marks; r0c2 two 31·0 on sewer bank, triangle; r1c0 blank marsh and join line; r1c1 blue drain, B.M.7·64; r1c2 drain with sluice box; r2c0 B.M.4·25 fence end; r2c1 N-S blue drain, 3·4, 4·0; r2c2 EAST lettering). Region views c4_reg1 (4x sewer crossing), c4_reg2 (5x LT&SR slopes), c4_reg3 (4x sewer crest and 14·0 wing), c4_reg4 (5x crossing and sidings). Contact sheets c4_A (8x), c4_B3 (8x smoothed + nearest), c4_C3 (12x smoothed + nearest, 6/8), c4_D (6x), c4_E (12x), c4_F3 (8x both filters) and c4_G (16x, B.M.7·89 8/9). Every image displayed when opened. Dot centroids by numeric helper; positions checked on a marker sheet.
legibility: clear print on mostly blank marsh; horizontal sheet join py ~571 (full width, thin line; same join as py ~570 on 131075_87143); sheet tool silent
